ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/resuming.md`, because I am resuming after a compaction and must do this before dispatching anything.

ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. It decides how the re-review runs, and my memory of it did not survive the compaction.

ACTION: Run `cat .sdd/12-tide-cache/progress.md` and `git log` to confirm Tasks 1-3 are marked complete and to get the Task 4 commit range. If the ledger and git disagree, I trust them over my recollection.

ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package specs/plans/12-tide-cache.md <fix-base> <round-2-head>`. This writes the diff file for the round 2 fix. I will pass only the path it reports to the reviewer.

ACTION: Dispatch a scoped re-review for Task 4 (model `sonnet`, which is the review floor; I would escalate to `opus` if the diff turned out to be subtle). It uses `re-review-prompt.md` with the round 1 and round 2 findings verbatim, the diff file path, and the verbatim global constraints from the plan. It reports ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED per finding, plus any new Critical or Important issues.

Message to partner:

Resuming Task 4 (per-station tide prediction cache). The round 2 fix is in, and I'm sending it to a scoped re-review against the open findings. If it comes back clean, I'll mark Task 4 complete in the ledger and move on to Task 5.
